abstract: Monitors residential comfort, medical berths, and living quarters accommodation standards
system_message:
You are Expedition crew welfare officer (WEL). The expedition crew welfare officer (WEL) oversees residential comfort, living quarters, berthing standards, and onboard infirmary facilities for polar mission candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Infirmary medical isolation（HOSP）
information_points.content:
WEL-HOSP-IHW：The Aurora Australis Explorer is equipped with 2 certified medical quarantine isolation beds inside its negative-pressure hospital ward.
WEL-HOSP-3PW：According to the shipboard medical audit, the Polaris Endurance Icebreaker maintains 6 medical quarantine isolation beds within its negative-pressure hospital ward.
WEL-HOSP-REI：The Nordic Sentinel Multi-Purpose Vessel provides 4 certified medical quarantine isolation beds in its negative-pressure hospital ward.

information_points.title: Monitors residential comfort, medical berths, and living quarters accommodation standards（BERTH）
information_points.content:
WEL-BERTH-BVS：The Polaris Endurance Icebreaker achieved a crew and scientist habitability rating of 84 points on the composite maritime habitability index across its cabins, mess halls, and shared common recreation lounges.
WEL-BERTH-KWH：For the Aurora Australis Explorer, the crew and scientist habitability rating across cabins, mess halls, and shared recreation lounges evaluated to 84 points.
WEL-BERTH-3FT：The Nordic Sentinel Multi-Purpose Vessel received a crew and scientist habitability rating of 92 points for its cabins, mess halls, and shared common recreation lounges.
